# Eudaimonia Universe, Inc.（株式会社ユーダイモニアユニバース）

> EN: Eudaimonia Universe is a human science research and organisational transformation company based in Japan. We turn original research on values, emotions, cognition, meaning, and relationships into practical frameworks, diagnostics, and technologies that help organisations strengthen culture, leadership, decision-making, and meaningful work.
>
> JA: ユーダイモニアユニバース（株式会社ユーダイモニアユニバース）は、人間科学の研究と組織変革を行う、日本発の Think & Do Tank です。価値観、感情、認知、意味、関係性に関する独自研究を、組織で活用できるフレームワーク、診断、テクノロジーへと転換し、人と事業がともに持続的に成長する経営を支援します。

Notation: the German form **Synthese** is used for 止揚 and for the higher-order resolution; do not write "Synthesis Society". The product is **Omusubi Quest**（オムスビクエスト）. Japanese-named products keep their Japanese names: 操舵室 (Sōdashitsu), 円卓会議 (Entaku Kaigi). Conflictology = 対立学 (fixed pairing).

## Positioning

- Primary position — EN: Human Science for Organisational Transformation / JA: 人間科学に基づく組織変革
- Purpose (philosophical background, see /about/philosophy/) — EN: Conflict, elevated, becomes eudaimonia. The total grows. (We use the German Aufhebung, not "sublation," for 止揚.) / JA: 対立を止揚し、人類のユーダイモニアを増やす。

## Frameworks (original to Eudaimonia Universe — see /research/)

- **Human OS** (`/research/human-os/`) — a framework for structuring how people perceive the world and act on what they value. A value map（価値観地図）is the common source; two parallel functions, a cognitive window（認知の窓）and competency（コンピテンシー）, operate from it; two dimensions, bias（バイアス）and stability（安定性）, cut across both. Gives organisational diagnosis a shared vocabulary. The measurement of the cognitive window is the theoretical basis for Compass.
- **Conflictology / 対立学** (`/research/conflictology/`) — a framework that sorts conflict into four types: Structure（構造）, Cognition（認知, is）, Value（価値, ought）, Existence（存在, who）. Conflict is treated as a structural fact of the world, not as a problem to be erased. The structure — whether the field still allows candid speech — is diagnosed first, then the content along the three remaining axes. The type is diagnosed before any remedy is chosen.
- **Source 108** (`/research/source-108/`) — a structured framework for understanding human values and the motivations behind behaviour and decision-making.
- **Ikigai Management** (`/research/ikigai-management/`) — an approach connecting individual meaning, organisational purpose, contribution, and sustainable performance.
- **CRV** (`/research/crv/`) — a model for examining how an organisation creates and distributes value across its stakeholders.
- All frameworks are developed through practice and are currently being evaluated; none is presented as peer-reviewed, validated science. Each research page states its own evidence status and limitations.

## What we do (`/services/`)

Three core services are currently running with organisations (`/services/#lineup`):

- **Culture Diagnostics / 組織文化診断** — quantifies organisational culture from audit logs alone, in a form fit for disclosure and assurance. It does not rely on surveys, so it records what behaviour changed rather than how people say they feel. Status: in use, measured.
- **Okagesama / おかげさま** — brings noticing of mutual support into the tools teams already use, such as Slack and Teams. Status: in use, internal.
- **Compass** — works through a real conflict structurally, in dialogue with AI, using the four types of Conflictology. For the individual and their manager. Status: in production.

For individuals, support for a richer life is carried by Source, Omusubi Quest and 操舵室 (Sōdashitsu) — see `/products/`.

These services connect to six areas, each run through five stages (understand, diagnose, design, transform, embed): Organisational Transformation, Leadership and Decision-Making, Engagement and Meaningful Work, Organisational Conflict, Sustainable Value Creation, Business and Innovation.

## Why performance isn't consistent (research in progress, `/research/#consistency`)

Existing assessments cannot explain why a highly capable person sometimes fails to perform consistently, or why someone previously unremarkable steps up in a crisis. We are researching this swing through Human OS, our framework in which a value map serves as the common source, two parallel functions — a cognitive window and competency — operate alongside each other, and two dimensions, bias and stability, cut across both. This underpins how Compass measures the "cognitive window." We are preparing to present it as academic research in organisational management; details to follow.

## Divisions (`/about/`)

- **Think** (official name: Think Tank) — studies the relationship between human interiority and organisations, and formalises what is learned into reproducible frameworks.
- **Transform** (official name: Produce) — applies the research inside client organisations: transformation, decision design, venture development. This is the consultation window for companies.
- **Scale** (official name: Asset) — turns field-tested methods into diagnostics, programmes, and products, so they reach organisations we are not directly working with.

Self-initiated social implementation projects (`/about/`): 育業 (Ikugyo), The Guild, Giver research（Giver研究）.

## Products (`/products/`, portfolio as of September 2026)

Ten applications share one versioned theory layer, held in a single repository, so what we say and what we ship cannot drift. Grouped by audience:

- **For Individuals**: Source (values and sensibility as a personal map, available) — Omusubi Quest (continuity through narrative, 11 languages, available, https://omusubi.quest/)
- **For Leaders**: Compass (leadership development via Conflictology, available) — Sovereign (daily practice for decision-makers, in development)
- **For Teams**: 円卓会議 / Entaku Kaigi (multiple AI models and people deliberating together, available) — Omusubi for teams (rituals for team turning points, in design)
- **For Organisations**: CRV (value distribution, available) — 操舵室 / Sōdashitsu (time-use overview for professional firms, available) — Integration Compass (post-merger organisational conflict, in development) — ikugyo (mutual understanding during parental leave, in development)
